defects.canonical: weighted_score divides the weighted sum (total) by the count of contributing rows instead of by the sum of weights; the result is a true weighted average only when all weights are equal, otherwise it is wrong (and can exceed the score range).
defects.why_subtle: The loop already accumulates a tidy `contributing` counter and a `total`, so `total / contributing` reads like a normal average; a skimmer has to notice no running weight-sum exists to divide by.
